scheduledPaymentDate.description: Date the daily sweep will process this installment (defaults to DueDate at creation).

isHeld.description: True when this installment has been manually paused from the remittance sweep.

holdReason.description: The reason provided when holding this installment, or null if not held.

remittanceId.description: Id of the remittance this installment belongs to, or null if not in a remittance.

remittanceSequence.description: 1-based sequence number of this installment within its remittance, or null if not in a remittance.

rail.description: "Remittance" when the installment can ride the automatic CNAB rail; "Manual" otherwise.

manualReason.description: The reason the installment cannot use the remittance rail, or null when Rail is "Remittance".
